sn14.31:1.2: pubbeva me bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhi sattasseva sato etadahosi
sn14.31:1.3: ko nu kho paṭhavīdhātuyā assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ
sn14.31:1.4: ko āpodhātuyā assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ
sn14.31:1.5: ko tejodhātuyā assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ
sn14.31:1.6: ko vāyodhātuyā assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇanti.
sn14.31:2.2: yaṃ kho paṭhavīdhātuṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ ayaṃ paṭhavīdhātuyā assādo
sn14.31:2.3: yaṃ paṭhavīdhātu 1 aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā ayaṃ paṭhavīdhātuyā ādīnavo
sn14.31:2.4: yo 2 paṭhavīdhātuyā chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ idaṃ paṭhavīdhātuyā nissaraṇaṃ.
sn14.31:2.7: yaṃ vāyodhātuṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ ayaṃ vāyodhātuyā assādo
sn14.31:2.8: yaṃ vāyodhātu aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā ayaṃ vāyodhātuyā ādīnavo
sn14.31:2.9: yo vāyodhātuyā chandarāgavinayo chanda rāgappahānaṃ idaṃ vāyodhātuyā nissaraṇaṃ.
sn14.31:3.1: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ catunnaṃ dhātūnaṃ evaṃ assā dañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ neva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho 1 paccaññāsiṃ.
sn14.31:4.1: yato ca khvāhaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ catunnaṃ dhātūnaṃ evaṃ assādañca assādato ādīna vañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ athāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇa brāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisam buddho paccaññāsiṃ.
sn14.31:4.3: akuppā me vimutti ayamantimā jāti natthidāni punabbhavoti.
